caption: The drawing depicts a round, clear glass object resembling a paperweight, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. Within the glass object are colorful, detailed designs: multiple swirling ribbons in pink, white, yellow, and purple, along with two prominently visible blue bands featuring white text that reads “Anna M. Brown” on the first band and “Bridgeton N.J.” on the second. The interior designs also include curling, vine-like patterns in similar pastel hues. In the top right corner of the drawing is a smaller, inset illustration showing the same object from a slightly different angle, encapsulated in a rectangle. Below the central image, there is a linear scale for measurement. At the bottom right corner of the page, there is a signature and date. The composition is balanced with the object centered, the inset in the upper right, and most of the surrounding space left empty.
title: Blown Glass
